title: The Teapot with the Sticky Lid
youtube_title: The Teapot with the Sticky Lid | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness is noticing who needs warmth and offering it first.
summary: When the salt-crusted lid of Mira's enamel teapot sticks shut on the dune picnic, she works it open and pours the first cup for the chilly lighthouse keeper.
